propositions: Retire three phantom SYNC-dependent output cells (orphaned, duplicates, stale) that never populate because rebar never wrote SYNC events, updating all consumers including CLI, schema, MCP model, and tests.
Keep unknown_event_types detection using a two-stage ref-based scan (git grep on refs/heads/tickets, then candidate blob validation) without requiring a checked-out tickets directory.
Add store_integrity as a fail-closed offline integrity audit that validates forward/reverse binding consistency with six specific finding kinds and gates fsck exit on any inconsistency.

Define operational Git failure semantics where missing executables, missing refs, malformed output, and grep/show failures raise RebarError(returncode=2) and cause CLI exit 2, mapping to MCP command_failed.
Preserve exit semantics where unknown_event_types findings remain informational (no exit change), binding_drift remains best-effort informational, and store_integrity findings gate with exit 1.

Remove SYNC-only machinery (_STALE_THRESHOLD_NS, _NS_THRESHOLD, _to_ns, --now-ts, reconciler liveness detection from stale context) while retaining BRIDGE_ALERT event emitter and bridge-status compatibility entrypoint.
